classification_rules.dominant: at least 40 percent of usable references or strong across two cohorts
classification_rules.outlier: one source or one creator pattern
classification_rules.unsuitable: conflicts with fidelity, rights, readability, or feasibility

patterns.finding: A real object or source image is the first visual anchor; text explains rather than replaces it.
patterns.transfer_rule: Use a neutral, explicitly empty source slot in the proof; do not reconstruct or embed the real note.

patterns.finding: One feature, crop, numbered point, or magnified region receives emphasis at a time.
patterns.transfer_rule: Use one bounded focus window or numbered focus card per cue.

patterns.finding: A short topic label or key term is larger than explanatory copy.
patterns.transfer_rule: Keep one Japanese action label and one feature term above the subtitle.

patterns.finding: A high-contrast lower band carries a short promise or dialogue text.
patterns.transfer_rule: Retain the approved subtitle safe area as a production constraint, not as copied styling.

patterns.finding: Dialogue explainers visibly distinguish two speakers, commonly with busts at edges or corners.
patterns.transfer_rule: Use neutral speaker nameplates only; no character art is authorized.

patterns.finding: Institutional identity or an image source caption stays adjacent to the evidence surface.
patterns.transfer_rule: Show compact reference IDs and the research-only rights boundary in a footer.

patterns.finding: Change is explained through angle states, a reveal, a process shot, or one focus shift.
patterns.transfer_rule: Storyboard one non-looping reveal or zoom per cue; do not infer playback quality.

patterns.finding: Neutral or source-derived fields keep the object and explanation dominant.
patterns.transfer_rule: Use charcoal and warm-white neutral glue; accents encode speaker or focus only.

patterns.finding: Publisher and creator packages are common but source-specific.
patterns.transfer_rule: Do not copy branded frames, character art, studio worlds, or a creator palette.

patterns.finding: Dense multi-image collage appears in individual thumbnails, not across cohorts.
patterns.transfer_rule: Reject as a full-frame proof grammar because it increases rights and comprehension burden.
